item.tib: gsas mkhar chen po gsang ba sgo dgu'i gdang dbyangs dbyar skyes sgra dbyangs
item.coloph: bder gshegs rgyal ba'i mkhyen dgongs bdud rtsi'i bcud/ rab bltams rin chen bum bzang snyigs dus kyi/ bstan dang 'gro ba'i gsos su sbyin mkhas pa/ sa gsum 'gran bral srid zhi'i dpal gcig pu/ blo ldan mchog sprul g.yung drung rgyal mtshan gyi/ snyan rgyud dri med gsas mkhar sum brgya'i gtso/ theg dgu bang mdzod lung chen sde dgu zhes/ gsas mkhar chen po gsang ba sgo dgu yi/ gdang (gdangs) dbyangs khyad 'phags dbyar skyes sgra dbyangs 'di/ mchog sprul bka' bzhin mu la'i ming can gyis/ 'dus sde chen po dpal ldan nor gling du/ rgyal ba mnyam med chen po'i snyan rgyud bzhin/ sangs rgyas bstan pa mdzes pa'i rgyan du spel/ 'di bris dge ba bdud rtsi'i zeg ma yis/ skye dgu'i nyon shes tha ba rab brlan zhing / tshogs gnyis bde skyid lo 'dab yal ga rgyas/ g.yung drung bstan pa'i pad tshal rab bzhed nas/ bla med byang chub 'bras bu smin gyur cig/
